outcome: One Major finding: false annulus coefficient criterion on the core cancellation proof chain; complete local repair, no main-theorem refutation.

findings.location: Proposition 5.19 proof, PDF/printed p.35 first display; bound TeX line 1267
findings.claim: All roots are in the open annulus iff |a_i| < max(r2^(n-i), |a0| r1^(-i))
findings.repair: Replace maximum by minimum, retaining r1^n < |a0| < r2^n. Necessity, sufficiency and contraction proven in report section 3.
findings.repair_verification: analytic proof plus exact rational counterexample check
findings.dependency: Proposition 5.19 -> annulus model and compactness used in Theorem 7.1 p.41
findings.counterevidence: Corrected fiber remains a contractible open polydisc; explicit coefficient scaling preserves the correct domain.
findings.impact: Invalidates the printed root-location equivalence used in the annulus proof. The minimum criterion and fiber contraction are proved in the report; no refutation of Proposition5.19 or cancellation and no complete reconstruction of all descent dependencies is claimed.
findings.severity_rationale: The false coefficient equivalence is used to identify the fibers in Proposition5.19; its annulus model and compactness are explicitly used in the cancellation proof, Theorem7.1 p41. A short local correction and survival of the theorem do not exclude a demonstrated invalid core derivation.
